prompts.display_text: Pin an African country with a temple under construction, not yet dedicated.
prompts.text_original: Pin an African country with a temple under construction but not yet dedicated (as of October 2026).
prompts.citation: Church temple list and ChurchofJesusChristTemples.org (temples under construction), read 26 Oct 2026
prompts.summary: As of October 2026, temples are under construction across Africa, including Freetown Sierra Leone, Cape Town South Africa, Kumasi Ghana, Antananarivo Madagascar, Brazzaville Republic of the Congo and Lubumbashi Democratic Republic of the Congo. Nigeria has two underway, at Benin City and Lagos. They will join dedicated temples such as Johannesburg (1985), Accra (2004), Kinshasa (2019) and Nairobi (2025).

prompts.display_text: Pin a present-day Mediterranean country that appears in Acts.
prompts.text_original: A present-day country on the Mediterranean that appears in Acts
prompts.summary: Acts follows the gospel outward along the Mediterranean coast. Peter worked at Joppa, believers gathered at Damascus and Antioch, men of Cyrene took part in the early Church, and Paul preached in Cyprus, Ephesus, Athens and Corinth. Paul's ship called at Tyre and Sidon, and after a shipwreck on Malta the book ends with him in Rome.

answers.name: Greece
answers.fact: Athens and Corinth feature in Acts 17-18.

answers.name: Italy
answers.fact: Acts ends with Paul in Rome.

answers.name: Cyprus
answers.fact: Barnabas and Paul preached across Cyprus.

answers.name: Israel
answers.fact: Joppa and Caesarea are on Israel's coast.

answers.name: Turkey
answers.fact: Ephesus and Antioch are major Acts cities.

answers.name: Egypt
answers.fact: Egypt is named at Pentecost and Apollos came from Alexandria.

answers.name: Malta
answers.fact: Paul was shipwrecked on Malta.

answers.name: Syria
answers.fact: Damascus, scene of Paul's conversion, is in Syria.

answers.name: Lebanon
answers.fact: Paul's ship called at Tyre and Sidon.

answers.name: Libya
answers.fact: Men of Cyrene appear in Acts 2, 6, 11 and 13.

answers.name: Palestine
answers.fact: Philip met the Ethiopian on the road down to Gaza (Acts 8:26), now in the Gaza Strip.

prompts.display_text: Pin a country that is home to Danish, French, German, Italian or Welsh, the first Book of Mormon translations.
prompts.text_original: The first five Book of Mormon translations (1851-1852) were Danish, French, German, Italian and Welsh. Pin the home country of one
prompts.citation: Encyclopedia of Mormonism, Book of Mormon Translations; BYU RSC
prompts.summary: The first Book of Mormon translations came out in 1851 and 1852, as missionaries carried the gospel through Europe. Danish came first, in 1851, under Erastus Snow; French, German, Italian and Welsh followed in 1852. The Italian edition was printed in London under Lorenzo Snow's direction.

answers.name: Germany
answers.fact: A team working in Hamburg finished the German translation in 1852.

answers.name: France
answers.fact: The French edition appeared in 1852 from the mission John Taylor opened in Paris.

answers.name: Denmark
answers.fact: Danish came first, in 1851, produced under Erastus Snow for the Scandinavian Mission.

answers.name: Italy
answers.fact: The 1852 Italian edition was printed in London under Lorenzo Snow's direction.

answers.name: United Kingdom
answers.fact: Welsh, spoken in Wales, got its edition in 1852 under John S. Davis.

prompts.display_text: Pin a country or territory where Maori, Dutch, Samoan, Tahitian, Turkish or Japanese is official or Indigenous.
prompts.text_original: A country or territory where Maori, Dutch, Samoan, Tahitian, Turkish or Japanese (Book of Mormon translations 1889-1909) is official or Indigenous
prompts.summary: Between 1889 and 1909 the Book of Mormon reached six new languages: Maori (1889), Dutch (1890), Samoan (1903), Tahitian (1904), Turkish (1906) and Japanese (1909). Dutch also serves Belgium's Flanders, Suriname and several Caribbean islands.

answers.name: Japan
answers.fact: The Japanese Book of Mormon appeared in 1909.

answers.name: New Zealand
answers.fact: The Maori Book of Mormon appeared in 1889.

answers.name: Netherlands
answers.fact: The Dutch Book of Mormon appeared in 1890.

answers.name: Samoa
answers.fact: The Samoan Book of Mormon appeared in 1903.

answers.name: French Polynesia
answers.fact: The Tahitian Book of Mormon appeared in 1904.

answers.name: Turkey
answers.fact: A Turkish Book of Mormon appeared in 1906.

answers.name: American Samoa
answers.fact: Samoan, translated 1903, is spoken and official in American Samoa.

answers.name: Belgium
answers.fact: Dutch, translated 1890, is official in Belgium's Flanders.

answers.name: Aruba

answers.name: Curacao

answers.name: Cyprus

answers.name: Suriname
